vBRIEFInfo.description: Project definition -- synthesized gestalt of the project.

narratives.Overview: CGDC2026 is a static micro website hosted from GitHub Pages.
narratives.Architecture: A single-repository static website. GitHub Actions publishes the repository root to GitHub Pages using the official Pages deployment actions.
narratives.ProjectConfig: Tech stack: HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript. Deployment: GitHub Pages via GitHub Actions. Workflow: edit static files, commit to main, push, and let the Pages workflow deploy.
narratives.Strategy: Use interview for future scoped changes unless the user asks for a direct implementation.
narratives.tech stack: HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript, GitHub Actions, GitHub Pages.
